name: Ootori Kanae
source:
Ootori Kanae is a well-endowed ojou-sama from a rich family with an influential history. She is currently employed in the GHQ as a First Lieutenant, and also ends up assisting Kageaki on his mission. She is well-mannered and walks around with an old lady as a personal servant, and likes to tease and flirt with Kageaki for fun.

[From http://awesomecurry.wordpress.com/]
